era_note: Atlanta, Georgia, 2017-2026. R3: living people and a live case. Per episode_spec, forbidden_subjects bars any depiction of a child, of blood or injury, of a funeral or grave, and of war or the military; none appears in any line or plate here. Per forbidden_claims, no Short states in the film's own voice that Martin was held at gunpoint for about an hour, that the agents were inside for no more than five minutes, or that no agent touched her -- the record holds both accounts and they cannot both be true, and none of the three angles goes near that dispute. No Short says or implies that Agent Guerra or the FBI lied; where the GPS is mentioned it is the Supreme Court's own sentence, followed by the film's own refusal to explain it.
plate_pool_note: 160 approved plates at remotion/public/wronghouse/img. Each plate below was used by the finished film under the same narration, so the picture already means what the line says. HOOK W002-W006, ACT_1 W011-W068, ACT_2 W069-W109, ACT_3 W110-W158, ENDING W159.

shorts.angle: Nobody on that team broke a rule, because the FBI has no rule that says check the address.
shorts.avoids: No child, no injury, no depiction of the entry. Does not say anyone lied or was negligent; quotes the court's record of what the Bureau requires and stops there.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: If no rule was broken, what is left for the family to sue over?
shorts.loop_join: The last line turns the answer of the first into the beginning of the problem.

lines.text: When the case reached a judge, the FBI's own representative was asked what the rules were. Not what the agent did. What the Bureau requires.
source_lines: Because when the case reached a judge, the FBI's own representative was asked what the rules were.
Not what Guerra did. What the Bureau *requires*.

lines.text: No FBI policy or procedure dictates how to locate or navigate to the target, whether to use a GPS device, or what type of GPS device must be used.
source_lines: "No FBI policy or procedure dictates how to locate or navigate to the target, whether to use a GPS device or what type of GPS device must be used, whether or how to conduct a site survey or drive-by of a target location, or how long to wait before entering after knocking and announcing."

lines.text: Whether or how to conduct a site survey or drive-by of a target location. Or how long to wait before entering after knocking and announcing.
source_lines: "No FBI policy or procedure dictates how to locate or navigate to the target, whether to use a GPS device or what type of GPS device must be used, whether or how to conduct a site survey or drive-by of a target location, or how long to wait before entering after knocking and announcing."

lines.text: There is no rule that says check the house number. There is no rule that says use Bureau equipment.
source_lines: There is no rule that says check the house number. There is no rule that says use Bureau equipment.

lines.text: There is no rule about whether you look at the place at all before you break into it. There is no rule about how long you wait after you knock.
source_lines: There is no rule about whether you look at the place at all before you break into it. There is no rule about how long you wait after you knock.

lines.text: Which means that on the morning of the eighteenth of October, twenty-seventeen, nobody in that team broke a rule.
source_lines: Which means that on the morning of the eighteenth of October, twenty-seventeen, nobody in that team broke a rule.

lines.text: Because there was no rule to break.
source_lines: Because there was no rule to break.

lines.text: And that sentence -- there was no rule to break -- is not the end of this family's problem. It is the beginning of it.
source_lines:
And that sentence — *there was no rule to break* — is not the end of this family's problem.
<!-- (re-hook 4) -->

It is the beginning of it.

shorts.angle: He navigated to the wrong house with his own GPS, steered by a car that belonged to the family he was about to raid.
shorts.avoids: No child, no injury, no depiction of the entry. Does not say the agent lied or destroyed evidence: the GPS sentence is the Supreme Court's, and the film's own refusal to explain it is kept in.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: Everything he saw confirmed he was at the right house. What was he looking at?
shorts.loop_join: The last line returns to the device the first line set out with.

lines.text: At about half past three that morning, two agents drove out to look at the target one last time.
source_lines: At about half past three that morning, Guerra and another agent drove out to look at the target one last time, to check that nothing unexpected was happening — that the occupants were not already awake.

lines.text: He dimmed his headlights so nobody would notice the car. And he navigated using a personal GPS device. His own. Not the Bureau's.
source_lines:
He dimmed his headlights so nobody would notice the car.
<!-- (DCT Drive-By) -->

And he navigated using a personal GPS device. His own. Not the Bureau's.

lines.text: It took him to 3756 Denville Trace. He was looking at the wrong house, and everything he saw confirmed he was at the right one.
source_lines:
It took him to 3756 Denville Trace.
<!-- (G-04 ✓ VERBATIM) -->

He was looking at the wrong house, and everything he saw confirmed he was at the right one.

lines.text: A tan split-level. A corner lot. A large tree. A stoop. He even saw a street sign that said Landau Lane.
source_lines: A tan split-level. A corner lot. A large tree. A stoop. Four windows to the right of it. He even saw a street sign that said Landau Lane — because this house faces Landau Lane too.

lines.text: There was one thing in the driveway that had not been there on his first visit. A black Camaro. He noted it as a landmark.
source_lines:
There was one thing in the driveway that had not been there on his first visit. A black Camaro.
<!-- (G-07 ✓ VERBATIM · G-09 ✓ VERBATIM) -->

He noted it as a landmark. Something to steer by in the dark, an hour and a half later.

lines.text: The man named in the warrant was not known to drive a black Camaro. The car he navigated by belonged to the family he was about to raid.
source_lines:
The man named in the warrant was not known to drive a black Camaro, or to know anybody who did.
<!-- (G-08 ✓ VERBATIM) -->

The car he navigated by belonged to the family he was about to raid.

lines.text: No one could confirm as much later, because Agent Guerra threw away his GPS device not long after the raid.
source_lines: "No one could confirm as much later because Agent Guerra threw away his GPS device not long after the raid."

lines.text: This film is not going to tell you why he threw it away, because no court has decided that.
source_lines: This film is not going to tell you why he threw it away, because no court has decided that, and one of them expressly refused to.

shorts.angle: Two hundred and twenty-three docket entries, a unanimous Supreme Court win, and not one of them is a trial.
shorts.avoids: No child, no injury, no depiction of the entry. States no outcome the record has not reached: the case is live and the film says so.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: They won at the Supreme Court unanimously and still have no trial. What is in the way?
shorts.loop_join: The last line answers the first count with the thing the count never contained.

lines.text: The district court file in this case now runs to two hundred and twenty-three entries.
source_lines: The district court file in this case now runs to two hundred and twenty-three entries.

lines.text: Motions, orders, depositions, a mediation, two reconsiderations, a judgment, an appeal, a Supreme Court, and a box of sealed envelopes that went to Washington and came back.
source_lines: Motions, orders, depositions, a mediation, two reconsiderations, a judgment, an appeal, a Supreme Court, and a box of sealed envelopes that went to Washington and came back.

lines.text: Not one of those entries is a trial.
source_lines: Not one of those entries is a trial.

lines.text: Seven years and eight months after the door came in, this family won at the Supreme Court of the United States, unanimously.
source_lines: Seven years and eight months after the door came in, this family won at the Supreme Court of the United States, unanimously.

lines.text: Winning that did not give them a trial. It did not give them a dollar. It did not decide whether they can sue at all.
source_lines: Because winning that did not give them a trial. It did not give them a dollar. It did not decide whether they can sue at all.

lines.text: It has been eight years, nine months and twenty-five days since six federal agents walked up the wrong driveway in the dark.
source_lines: It has been eight years, nine months and twenty-five days since six federal agents walked up the wrong driveway in the dark.

lines.text: Nobody has been found liable. Nobody has been disciplined on any record this film could find. No damages have been awarded. No jury has heard a word of it.
source_lines: Nobody has been found liable. Nobody has been disciplined on any record this film could find. No damages have been awarded. No jury has heard a word of it.

lines.text: And the only thing anyone can say with certainty about what happens next is that nobody knows.
source_lines: And the only thing anyone can say with certainty about what happens next is that nobody knows.
